internalNote: Built from Kevin's own per-song extraction CSV (EaI1802_cumulative_extraction.csv, corrected), 105 songs, pages 17-99 (front matter and rudiments pages 1-16 have no song data; a title index confirmed present but used only for cross-checking, not as a separate source). Neither placePublished nor publisher are printed on the supplied title page and remain unresolved. Publication year 1802 is confirmed by Kevin directly as a recorded fact, despite not being printed on the supplied title page itself. Two apparent gaps surfaced during review and were resolved directly with Kevin against the real, physical page images before this build: page 30 is bare (just "Russia"), not split - the small fragment beside it is Calvary's own continuation from page 29.3, which also prints a "Lyric Poems" label, noted on Calvary's own record rather than treated as a real, separate tune; and page 68 is likewise bare (just "Sunday"), with the fragment below it (headed "Water") being Still-Water's own continuation from page 67b, not an independent tune. Continuation fragments are not assigned separate rows throughout, consistent with the rest of this extraction. No index cross-check against the book's own title index has been done yet beyond the extraction's own use of it for spot-checking; this is a first-pass build from the corrected extraction CSV.
